subject: Quarterbacking: QBR prep — consolidated forecast + account snapshots
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@acme.com>
Cc: Helen Park <helen@cloudops.io>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quarterbacking: QBR prep — consolidated forecast + account snapshots

Team / Miguel —

Thanks for the early sync. We have a compressed window before the QBR so I want to make this as actionable as possible (quarterbacking style). Attached is a first-pass rollup (QBR_account_rollup_v3.xlsx) and the draft MAP for Bluecrest. High-level asks: 

1) Account one-pagers: please add an "ask and risk" line for each account you own in the rollup tab. Focus on the top 12 accounts for runway and likelihood.
2) Forecast sanity: call out any out-of-cycle adjustments (e.g., pending legal, procurement hold, or discounts). Mark them as P1/P2/P3.
3) Mutually aligned next step with customers: Miguel/Bluecrest — confirm the target close quarter and any outstanding procurement artifacts.

Deadline: EOD PT Tuesday (2027-06-01) for account one-pagers; I will consolidate Wednesday morning.

Quick notes on format — keep the summaries to 3 bullets: current ARR, signal for close (evidence), and blocker (if any). Example row in the rollup: 
- Bluecrest Software — $540k ARR; demo + exec sponsor confirmed; legal redline in review (P2).

I'll run a 45-min recon on Thursday to stitch the final forecast. Marcus / Tessa — I want you to lead the recon for the west accounts; Karthik / Laura you cover enterprise and mid-market respectively.

Attachments: QBR_account_rollup_v3.xlsx; Bluecrest_Mutual_Action_Plan.pdf

Jonas
VP, Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@acme.com>, Helen Park <helen@cloudops.io>
Date: 2027-05-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterbacking: QBR prep — consolidated forecast + account snapshots

Jonas —

Received. I made a few edits to the rollup and added preliminary P1/P2 flags for the following accounts: 
- Bluecrest Software — moved to P1 (legal needs NDA clause; procurement timeline updated to end of June).
- Solaro Health — P2 (exec sync set but procurement TBD).
- Nimbus Analytics — P3 (exploratory).

Attached: brief_export_forecast_delta.csv (I pasted key deltas into the rollup next to each account for visibility).

Heads-up: for Bluecrest I pinged Miguel to confirm whether the contract review can be accelerated; he says his legal team expects a review window of ~10 business days after we deliver the signed SOW. Miguel — if that's accurate, please confirm whether we should target an earlier internal review of the SOW to shave days off.

I can own the consolidated numbers in Wednesday's morning pass.

— Karthik
Director, Enterprise Sales

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@acme.com>
Date: 2027-05-30T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterbacking: QBR prep — consolidated forecast + account snapshots

Jonas / team —

Thanks — I added concise account summaries for my book and flagged three accounts where we should consider "managed close" (close by legal + exec join): Bluecrest (P1), Meridian Financial (P1), and Atlas Retail (P2). A few observations: 

- Forecast uplift assumption: several owner notes assumed an optimistic ramp in usage; I standardized to conservative consumption for forecast modeling (see column "forecast_assumption_note").
- Risk tags: I used red/amber/green in the rollup; red means blocker on procurement/legal.
- Attachments: pushed a quick one-pager for Bluecrest into the Drive link (in case Miguel wants to forward to his legal).

Proposed recon agenda for Thursday: 
1) Run through P1 accounts by exception (10 min each).
2) Confirm owner and expected close evidence.
3) Agree final numbers and commit to communication cadence post-QBR.

If we keep to the 45-min window we should be able to finalize the submission for the exec deck.

Laura
Head of Sales Ops

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, tessa.morgan@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com, Miguel Torres <miguel.torres@acme.com>
Cc: Helen Park <helen@cloudops.io>
Date: 2027-05-30T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quarterbacking: QBR prep — consolidated forecast + account snapshots

Appreciate the quick turnaround and the flags. Final captain's notes before the recon: 

Action items (owners):
- Karthik: finalize consolidated forecast sheet and push final numbers to the rollup (by 08:00 PT 2027-06-02).
- Laura: prepare the P1 exception slide with an evidence bullet for each — include procurement owners and expected date (by 08:00 PT 2027-06-02).
- Marcus / Tessa: validate west-region accounts and call out any local procurement delays (by EOD 2027-05-31).
- Miguel: confirm whether Bluecrest legal can run an internal review on the draft SOW earlier than standard (reply to this thread).

Recon invite: Thursday 2027-06-03 10:00–10:45 PT (calendar invite sent). Please come with the three-bullet one-pagers in the rollup and any supporting docs linked in the Drive.

If anyone is blocked, escalate to me directly. We will treat this submission as the canonical input to the exec QBR deck.

Thanks — see you Thursday.

Jonas
VP, Sales Strategy
Redwood Inference
